name: test-suite-composition
description: Composes owned checks into explicit, proportionate execution bundles with clear admission, check depth, prerequisites, cost, result meaning, and recovery. Applies when test discovery, selective CI, change-impact routing, shared setup, selective reruns, or cross-runner coordination becomes difficult.

contract.what: A source-owned map and executable composition of existing checks for a named receiving decision.
when: A repository has overlapping commands, several runners, hidden prerequisites, uncertain blast radius, repeated unaffected work, or a slow lane whose expensive phase remains unclear.
boundaries: Domain owners retain expectations. Runner choice follows demonstrated capability. Required security, accessibility, integrity, publication, live-service, and budget gates remain explicit. Research predictions retain only the authority granted by their protocol.
contract.result: A discoverable route whose selected checks, inputs, environment, cost phases, side effects, outcomes, expansion events, and re-entry conditions are inspectable before execution.

receivingUse.job: A repository has overlapping commands, several runners, hidden prerequisites, uncertain blast radius, repeated unaffected work, or a slow lane whose expensive phase remains unclear.
receivingUse.materialResult: A discoverable route whose selected checks, inputs, environment, cost phases, side effects, outcomes, expansion events, and re-entry conditions are inspectable before execution.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
